themes.name: Agentic AI research
themes.description: Focuses on AI agents that can independently perform research tasks, make decisions, and take actions within a research context.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Covers tools and platforms designed to assist researchers in various stages of the research process, from data collection to analysis.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Explores AI tools that help developers write, debug, and optimize code, acting as assistants in the software development lifecycle.

themes.name: AI workforce impact
themes.description: Discusses how AI is affecting jobs, recruitment, reskilling, and the overall labor market, including potential job displacement and creation.

themes.name: Synthetic users
themes.description: Deals with the creation and use of artificial user personas or data to simulate real user behavior for testing and analysis.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Covers the use of AI to condense large amounts of text or data into concise summaries for quick understanding and insight extraction.

themes.name: AI design research
themes.description: Focuses on how AI is being used to inform and enhance the design process, from generating design ideas to analyzing design effectiveness.

themes.name: AI for product management
themes.description: Explores how AI applications are being leveraged to support product managers in areas like strategy, roadmapping, and market analysis.

themes.name: AI ethics in research
themes.description: Addresses the ethical considerations, biases, and responsible development practices when applying AI in research and user experience.

themes.name: AI usability testing
themes.description: Covers the application of AI in automating or augmenting the process of testing product usability and user experience.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
